question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Comprehensive
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Comprehensive **(adjective): Including or dealing with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something.(विस्तृत)

 
 
• **Example:** The report provides a comprehensive analysis of the situation.
 
 
 
• **Superficial** (adjective): Existing or occurring at or on the surface.(सतही)
 
 
• **Example:** He gave only a superficial examination of the problem.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym is **'superficial.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) Complete (पूरा):** This is a synonym of "comprehensive" rather than an antonym. Both words convey the idea of entirety or thoroughness.
 
• **Option 2) Through (पूरा):** This is not directly opposite to "comprehensive." "Through" means finished or done with, but it doesn't necessarily imply a lack of thoroughness.
 
• **Option 3) Exhaustive (थकाने वाला): **This is a synonym of "comprehensive" rather than an antonym. Both words convey the idea of covering all aspects thoroughly.
